title: Farshe Aza Bichao Majaalis Bapa Karo
body:
Karbala Karbala Karbala Karbala...(2)
Haalat O Waqiyat Nahi Rok Sakenge,
Ishq E Gham E Hussain (a.s) Mere Dil Ka Chain Hai,
Kisne Kaha Hussain (a.s) Faqat Karbala Mein Hain,
Aashiq Ke Dil Me Ghar Me Humesha Hussain (a.s) Hain...

Iss Baar Apne Ghar Ko Hi Karbobala Karo...

Haqq E Aza Khuloos O Wafa Se Ada Karo,

Kab Dur Hain Hussain (a.s) Azadar Se Bhala..(2)

Iss Baar Apne Ghar Ko Hi Karbobala Karo...

Rasm O Riwaaj Deen Ki Tabligh Nahi Hai..(2)

Gaibat Me Muntazir Hain Mere Waqt Ke Imam (a.t.f.s)..(2)
